newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria bomb kills school girl, wounds another.
newsitem.headline: Algeria bomb kills school girl, wounds another.

text.p: A bomb explosion killed a secondary school girl and wounded another on Saturday outside a school in the coastal province of Tipaza, 60 km (37 miles) west of Algiers, Algerian security forces said.
A statement by the official Algerian news agency APS said security forces reported the explosion occured at 12.10 a.m. (1110 GMT) in the town of Douaouda .
Moslem guerrillas have been blamed for the deaths of 49 civilians this month in the neighbouring province of Blida, including 20 bus passengers.
Another 60 civilians died in November in Blida and Algiers in guerrillas raids and bombings, including 10 killed by a car bomb in Algiers's southwestern suburb of Birkhadem.
About 60,000 people have died in Algeria since early 1992 when authorities cancelled a general election radical Islamists were poised to win.
